title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Rowan is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Northhaven.

Our stack: kotlin. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and ship features end to end.

Flexible hours.
